verdict.rationale: Insomnia's first-party docs state that it integrates with external vault service providers to retrieve secret values automatically when sending requests. That satisfies the story's 'external vault integration' branch, keeping credentials out of shared collection and environment files. Missing for 10: which vault providers are supported and how they are configured, evidence of masked or secret-type environment variables, and independent or hands-on corroboration that vault-resolved secrets stay out of synced or Git-shared files.
